metadata.source: Dubai Mainland (DET) & Free Zone Published Fee Schedules

jurisdictions.name: Dubai Mainland (DET)
jurisdictions.notes: Allows direct trading across UAE mainland and government tenders; physical office with DLD Ejari registration required.

jurisdictions.name: International Free Zone Authority (IFZA)
jurisdictions.notes: Fast remote setup; flexi-desk included up to 3 visas without external DLD Ejari filing.

jurisdictions.name: Dubai Multi Commodities Centre (DMCC)
jurisdictions.notes: High international enterprise credibility in JLT; uses DMCC internal property registry rather than mainland Ejari. Certain visa categories may still require Ejari.

jurisdictions.name: Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC)
jurisdictions.notes: Independent English common-law jurisdiction; ideal for regulated FinTech and institutional AI ventures.
